items.title: Zeke Mullins interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 9, 2017
items.q: She was, one thing about her, she was a really stern businesswoman but you know, if she saw that you knew your job and what you were doing was good for the band, she wouldn’t stand in the way.

ctx.x: Were you ever successful in getting a raise?

Yeah. She was, one thing about her, she was a really stern businesswoman but you know, if she saw that you knew your job and what you were doing was good for the band, she wouldn’t stand in the way. She wouldn’t stand in the way. And she’d tell Hamp, she’d
say, you know, “let me offer these musicians — let them exhibit their talents as they can” you know.
